paper_title: Can 1B LLM Surpass 405B LLM Rethinking Compute-Optimal Test-Time   Scaling
caption: Comparison between the performance of smaller LLMs compute-optimal TTS and that of larger LLMs CoT on MATH-500 and AIME24. (a) & (d) Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct surpasses Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct and GPT-4o on MATH-500 and AIME24; (b) & (e) DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B outperforms o1-preview on MATH-500 and AIME24, and surpasses o1-mini on MATH-500; (c) & (f) DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B beats o1 on MATH-500 and AIME24, and exceeds DeepSeek-R1 on AIME24.
model_annotation: This bar chart compares the performance of various large language models (LLMs) on two benchmark tests, MATH-500 and AIME24, under two different prompting strategies: Compute-Optimal Test-Time Scaling (TTS) and Chain-of-Thought (CoT). The chart is divided into six subplots: (a) and (d) for MATH-500, (b) and (e) for MATH-500 with different model sizes, and (c) and (f) for AIME24. The horizontal axis in each subplot represents the model size or type, labeled as “3B”, “405B”, “1.5B”, “671B”, “7B”, “unk”, or “7B”, “671B”, “unk” respectively, while the vertical axis represents performance scores, scaled linearly from 0 to 100 for MATH-500 plots (a), (b), (c) and from 0 to 90 for AIME24 plots (d), (e), (f). Each bar is color-coded and patterned according to the model and prompting strategy, as indicated in the legend: white (CoT), blue diagonal stripes (Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct), green (Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct), pink (o1-mini), gold (DeepSeek-R1), red diagonal stripes (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B), brown (o1-preview), and gray (o1). In subplot (a), the Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct (blue stripes) achieves 78.2, outperforming the Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct (green, 71.4) and GPT-4o (purple, 74.6). In subplot (b), the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B (red stripes) scores 91.6, surpassing o1-preview (brown, 85.5) and o1-mini (pink, 90.0). In subplot (c), the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B (red stripes) scores 94.8, outperforming o1 (gray, 94.8) and DeepSeek-R1 (gold, 97.3). In subplot (d), the Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct (blue stripes) scores 30.0, outperforming the Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct (green, 23.3) and GPT-4o (purple, 9.3). In subplot (e), the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B (red stripes) scores 63.3, surpassing o1-mini (pink, 63.6) and o1-preview (brown, 44.6). In subplot (f), the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B (red stripes) scores 83.3, outperforming o1 (gray, 79.2) and DeepSeek-R1 (gold, 79.8). The bars are generally sorted in descending order of performance within each subplot.
